name: Live Urgent Care King of Prussia
address: Town Center Road, King of Prussia, PA 19406
description: Live Urgent Care in King of Prussia is a walk-in clinic open 7 days a week for pediatric and adult patients, with sick visits, injuries and on-site x-rays, lab testing, physicals, occupational medicine, and telehealth.
tagline: Walk-in urgent care, open 7 days a week

hero.eyebrow: King of Prussia, PA | Urgent care
hero.headline: Care when the calendar will not give
hero.sub: Don't let sickness slow you down. Walk in or book ahead for same-day treatment, 7 days a week, pediatric and adult.

glassFloat.title: Open 7 days a week
glassFloat.sub: Town Center Road, via DeKalb Road

offerings.heading: Walk in for <mark>any of these.</mark>
items: Sick visits: colds, flu, COVID, strep, UTIs, ear infections, and more
Injuries and x-rays: sprains, fractures, cuts, and burns, with on-site imaging
Lab work and testing, physicals, occupational medicine, women's health, skin care, and telehealth
Pediatric patients from 6 months and adults
Parking in front on the Town Center Road side

story.heading: Same-day care for the whole area
paragraphs: The King of Prussia clinic sits on Town Center Road, accessible via DeKalb Road, serving Norristown, Bridgeport, Wayne, Conshohocken, and Valley Forge.
Walk in or book ahead, no referral needed, children from 6 months and adults.

experience.heading: How a visit goes
items: Book online or walk in; parking is in front.
Imaging and lab work on site, answers the same visit.
Follow up through the portal or by telehealth.

feature.heading: Physicals and occupational medicine
feature.text: DOT, sports, school, and pre-employment physicals, plus drug testing, workers' comp, and screenings for local employers.

closing.heading: Walk in or book ahead, 7 days a week
